headline: Nevish and Weathered See Renewed Base Churn
war_summary: Nevish Line has swung from an even four-to-four division to six Colonial posts against two Warden, with no neutral bases; five event rows were recorded in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse is more unsettled still: its present tally is two bases for each side and five neutral, against five Colonial, one Warden and three neutral in the last edition. Seven event rows there in two hours accompany sharply rising casualty rates. Stonecradle, quiet in the previous two-hour window, has now logged six events in two hours; its current count stands at eight Colonial and one Warden. Linn’s Mercy remains at eight Colonial, two Warden and one neutral, with no events in the latest two hours but three in six. Mooring County’s eleven-to-one Warden lead is unchanged, though three events were logged in six hours amid accelerating casualties. Marban Hollow’s mixed four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-neutral position also holds; its latest recorded base event was many hours ago. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
